description: This PHP source file defines the ViewList class, which extends SugarView, responsible for handling the list view interface in the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for preparing, processing, and displaying list views, handling search forms, and managing list view definitions for modules.

classes.name: ViewList
classes.description: A class that manages the list view rendering, search, and data handling within the SuiteCRM framework, facilitating list display, search form setup, processing, and user interaction.

methods.name: listViewPrepare
methods.description: Prepares the list view by loading metadata, setting display columns, and initializing the list view and search form.

methods.name: listViewProcess
methods.description: Processes the list view by executing search and display routines, including handling search form and rendering the list.

methods.name: prepareSearchForm
methods.description: Sets up the search form object based on module configurations and user request parameters.

methods.name: processSearchForm
methods.description: Handles the search logic by interpreting request parameters, generating search conditions, and updating the where clause.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Initializes the ListViewSmarty object before rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the list view if the user has list access; otherwise, shows an access denied message.

methods.name: getSearchForm2
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of SearchForm2 with given parameters.
